scripts.cf:build: npm run build && mkdir -p cloudflare/public/assets && cp index.html cloudflare/public/index.html && cp style.css cloudflare/public/style.css && cp dist/script.js cloudflare/public/script.js && cp assets/mock-video.mp4 cloudflare/public/assets/mock-video.mp4
scripts.cf:dev: npm run cf:build && npx wrangler dev --config cloudflare/wrangler.toml
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run cf:build && npx wrangler deploy --config cloudflare/wrangler.toml
